prompt: Explain quantum entanglement like I am 5.
response: Okay, imagine you have two magic stickers. These stickers are special because whatever you do to one sticker, the other sticker knows and changes too, no matter how far apart they are! So, if you make the first sticker turn red, the second sticker will also turn red at the same time, even if it's all the way across the room or even in another city. Scientists call this special connection between the stickers "quantum entanglement." It's like the stickers are best friends and can always tell what's happening to each other, no matter how far apart they are!
